render_point_cloud: render a PyTorch3D point cloud to a camera view and return an ImplicitronRender object
paste_render_to_original_image: paste a cropped render back into the original image coordinate frame using FrameData
get_sequence_pointcloud: generate a 3D point cloud for a CO3D dataset sequence by unprojecting depth maps
get_eval_frame_data_pointcloud: generate a point cloud by unprojecting depth maps from a FrameData object
subsample_pointcloud: subsample a PyTorch3D Pointclouds object to a maximum number of points randomly
